decisions.scenario: Finding a Monday train from Cambridge to Bishops Stortford and checking the fare

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I'm looking for a train to Bishops Stortford that arrives by 21:30.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: What day will you be travelling?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I would like to travel on Monday.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: There are eight trains that match your search. Would you like the one closest to your requested arrival time?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Yes, please.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: I recommend train TR8244, which leaves at 19:29. Would you like to reserve any seats?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I only need the price, but could you confirm that the train leaves from Cambridge?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Yes, it leaves from Cambridge. The fare is 10.10 pounds.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: That is perfect. Thank you very much for your help.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: You are welcome. Goodbye!
